items.title: wangzan101/Mika
items.why: It is a practical on-device AI agent project you can explore and test on Android.
items.summary: Mika is an open-source Android AI agent that can automatically navigate mobile apps and web pages to perform tasks for you.

items.title: caru-ini/stack-diagram
items.why: It is a useful practical tool to quickly document and visualize system architecture for your student projects.
items.summary: Stack Diagram is an AI prompt skill that takes a plain English description of your tech stack and generates a visual system architecture diagram.

items.title: Launch HN: Momentic (YC W24) – Agents that catch bugs by using your app
items.why: It demonstrates a practical software engineering use case for AI agents in quality assurance.
items.summary: Momentic provides autonomous AI testing agents that navigate mobile and web applications to discover and report software bugs.

items.title: heydamir/unslop
items.why: This tool helps you quickly turn basic AI-generated frontend code into clean, well-designed user interfaces.
items.summary: Unslop is a Claude extension tool that automatically cleans up generic AI-generated interface designs into polished user interfaces.

items.title: Arjun-Ingole/hop
items.why: It is a practical tool if you want to easily set up a dual-boot Linux development environment.
items.summary: Hop is an open-source utility that lets users install Linux side-by-side with Windows without needing a USB drive.

items.title: Jobless tech workers are being left out of San Francisco's AI boom
items.why: It provides valuable realistic perspective on current entry-level tech hiring trends and the software job market.
items.summary: A discussion on how unemployed tech workers in San Francisco are struggling to land roles despite massive investments in the local AI sector.

items.title: storytold/craft-anything
items.why: It is an practical learning resource for strengthening your core programming skills through hands-on projects.
items.summary: Craft Anything is an open-source educational repository that teaches how software works by guiding you to build your own implementations.

items.title: Show HN: HackerBooks – HackerTube, but for books mentioned on HN
items.why: It offers an easy way to discover highly recommended software engineering and computer science books.
items.summary: HackerBooks is a curated web application listing over 16,000 computer science and tech books recommended on Hacker News since 2007.

items.title: Anthropic's internal AI use, at retail prices, now exceeds its employee pay
items.why: It highlights how heavily leading AI research companies rely on their own LLM products internally.
items.summary: Anthropic revealed that the internal cost of its own engineers running Claude models has surpassed total employee salary expenditures.

items.title: Scaling Git at OpenAI
items.why: Learning how major tech companies handle massive codebases provides great real-world software engineering insight.
items.summary: OpenAI shared the technical strategies and custom tooling required to manage exceptionally large Git version control repositories at scale.

items.title: AI chatbots are becoming political advisers. Their answers can mislead voters
items.why: It explores important real-world societal impacts and reliability limitations of current LLM chatbots.
items.summary: An NPR report details how voters increasingly turn to AI chatbots for election news despite frequent factual errors and biased candidate recommendations.

items.title: Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says
items.why: This covers a major international news event regarding the ongoing conflict in Ukraine.
items.summary: Russian aerial strikes hit a Ukrainian village school serving as a humanitarian aid center, killing at least 26 people.

items.title: Iran war live: US carries out ‘defensive’ strikes in Strait of Hormuz
items.why: It reports critical breaking world news regarding geopolitical tensions along key global trade lanes.
items.summary: US military forces launched targeted defensive strikes against Iranian military positions in the Strait of Hormuz following missile threats.

items.title: Ebola outbreak kills more than 5,300 people in DR Congo
items.why: This is a major global health news development affecting central Africa.
items.summary: A severe Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has resulted in over 5,300 deaths and spread to neighboring African countries.
